config.aiProvider: Model provider for tasks inside the workbench.
config.codexPath: Optional path to the signed-in Codex CLI executable.
extension.description: Record, replay, and diagnose HarmonyOS UI workflows from VS Code.
workspaceTrust.description: Harmony Agent runs local tools and can execute pytest cases from the workspace.
command.askAI: Run a Phone Task with AI
config.cliPath: Path to the installed harmony-agent executable. Leave blank to use HARMONY_AGENT_CLI or the executable on PATH.
config.hdcPath: Optional path to the local HDC executable. Leave blank to let Harmony Agent discover it.
config.mcpPythonPath: Python interpreter with harmony-automation-agent installed for the MCP server. Leave blank to use the Python environment of the Workbench CLI.
config.codexProjectPath: Local project to open in Codex desktop. Leave blank to use the current local workspace or choose a folder.
config.stateDir: Absolute directory for shared device sessions and run evidence. Leave empty for VS Code’s per-workspace storage. Reload after changing.
config.language: Workbench language. Auto follows the VS Code display language.
